note: Extra fields for the tickets in demo/tickets.csv, keyed by ticket id. Defaults when a key is missing: emergency_flag false, ai_handling_status 'Not Started', vendor_brief '', notes '', repair_date '', repair_summary '', equipment_ids [], attachments [], receipts []. The ticket is the single source of truth for linked repairs: the servicing company is the ticket's Assigned To, the cost and cost date are the ticket's, and repair_date, repair_summary and receipts live here with the ticket. Equipment history is built from the tickets whose equipment_ids include an item and only references these fields (nothing is copied). A receipt is a durable reference (id, filename, mime, size); seeded demo receipts also carry a file path, files added in the demo are stored in the browser (IndexedDB) under their id.
